<div data-elementor-type="wp-page" data-elementor-id="32" class="elementor elementor-32" data-elementor-post-type="page">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-1c76f13 e-flex e-con-boxed e-con e-parent" data-id="1c76f13" data-element_type="container" data-e-type="container">
					<div class="e-con-inner">
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-c1ee99a elementor-widget elementor-widget-html" data-id="c1ee99a" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="html.default">
					<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Dashboard - SurveyPesa</title>
<link rel="icon" href="{{FAVICON}}">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Sora:wght@500;600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --navy:#001f3f;
    --navy-soft:#003366;
    --green:#32CD32;
    --green-deep:#228B22;
    --gold:#FFD700;
    --gold-deep:#FFA500;
    --bg:#f4f7f5;
    --card:#ffffff;
    --ink:#001f3f;
    --ink-muted:#5b6478;
    --line:#e6ebe7;
    --amber:#c9820b;
    --amber-bg:#fdf3e3;
    --radius-lg:18px;
    --radius-md:12px;
    --shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,31,63,0.06);
  }
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
  button{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;background:none;border:none;font-family:inherit;}
  body{
    font-family:'Inter',-apple-system,sans-serif;
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--ink);
    min-height:100vh;
    padding-bottom:84px;
  }
  h1,h2,h3,.display{font-family:'Sora',sans-serif;}

  /* ===== Payout ticker ===== */
  .payout-ticker{
    background:var(--navy-soft);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;padding:8px 0;
    border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  }
  .ticker-track{display:inline-flex;gap:32px;animation:tickerScroll 32s linear infinite;will-change:transform;}
  .ticker-item{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:#e7ecf7;font-size:0.78rem;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;}
  .ticker-item .ic{
    width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);color:#fff;
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:0.6rem;flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .ticker-item .amt{color:#8be89a;font-weight:700;}
  @keyframes tickerScroll{ from{transform:translateX(0);} to{transform:translateX(-50%);} }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ .ticker-track{animation:none;} }

  .q-progress{font-size:0.7rem;color:var(--ink-muted);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px;}

  /* ===== Header ===== */
  .header{
    background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--navy) 0%, var(--navy-soft) 100%);
    color:#fff;
    padding:18px 16px 22px;
  }
  .header-content{max-width:600px;margin:0 auto;}
  .header-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .logo-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
  .logo-row img{height:26px;display:block;}
  .logo-text{font-family:'Sora',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;letter-spacing:-0.01em;}
  .verified-chip{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;
    background:rgba(47,174,62,0.18);
    border:1px solid rgba(47,174,62,0.4);
    color:#7be08a;
    padding:5px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-size:0.7rem;font-weight:600;
  }
  .greeting{font-size:0.95rem;color:#c7cfe0;margin-bottom:2px;}
  .greeting strong{color:#fff;}

  /* ===== Balance card ===== */
  .balance-card{
    background:#0e2148;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    color:#fff;
    padding:20px;
    border-radius:var(--radius-lg);
    margin-top:14px;
  }
  .balance-label{font-size:0.8rem;color:#9aa6c2;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .balance-row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .balance-amount{font-family:'Sora',sans-serif;font-size:2.3rem;font-weight:700;color:#fff;}
  .balance-currency{font-size:0.9rem;color:#9aa6c2;font-weight:600;}
  .balance-note{
    display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;font-size:0.78rem;color:#c7cfe0;line-height:1.4;margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .action-buttons{display:flex;gap:10px;}
  .btn{
    flex:1;padding:13px 10px;border-radius:10px;border:none;font-weight:700;
    font-size:0.88rem;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;transition:transform .15s ease, opacity .15s ease;
  }
  .btn:active{transform:scale(0.98);}
  .btn-withdraw{background:#fff;color:var(--navy);}
  .btn-earn{background:var(--green-deep);color:#ffffff !important;text-decoration:none;}
  .min-note{font-size:0.7rem;color:#7f8bab;text-align:center;margin-top:8px;}

  .container{max-width:600px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px 12px 0;}

  /* ===== Trust strip ===== */
  .trust-strip{
    display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding:14px 2px 4px;
    scrollbar-width:none;
  }
  .trust-strip::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
  .trust-item{
    flex:0 0 auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
    background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:8px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--ink-muted);font-weight:500;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  }
  .trust-item span.dot{color:var(--green);font-size:0.9rem;}

  /* ===== Register prompt card (compact) ===== */
  .register-card{
    background:var(--navy);
    border-radius:var(--radius-md);
    padding:12px 14px;
    margin:14px 0;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:12px;
  }
  .register-icon{font-size:1.3rem;flex-shrink:0;}
  .register-body{flex:1;min-width:0;}
  .register-title{font-family:'Sora',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:0.85rem;color:#fff;line-height:1.3;}
  .register-sub{font-size:0.72rem;color:#9aa6c2;margin-top:1px;}
  .register-btn{
    background:var(--green-deep);color:#ffffff !important;border:none;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:8px;
    font-weight:700;font-size:0.78rem;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;
    text-decoration:none;
  }

  /* ===== Welcome task (real, unconditional) ===== */
  .welcome-card{
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff 0%, #f2fbf3 100%);
    border:1.5px solid rgba(47,174,62,0.35);
    border-radius:var(--radius-lg);
    padding:18px;
    margin:16px 0;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .welcome-card .ribbon{
    position:absolute;top:14px;right:-34px;
    background:var(--green);color:#fff;font-size:0.68rem;font-weight:700;
    padding:4px 40px;transform:rotate(35deg);letter-spacing:0.03em;
  }
  .welcome-head{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .welcome-icon{
    width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--green);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.3rem;flex-shrink:0;color:#fff;
  }
  .welcome-title{font-family:'Sora',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:2px;}
  .welcome-sub{font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--ink-muted);}
  .welcome-reward{
    font-family:'Sora',sans-serif;font-weight:700;color:var(--green-deep);font-size:1.15rem;margin:10px 0 4px;
  }
  .welcome-reward small{font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-muted);font-size:0.75rem;}
  .welcome-desc{font-size:0.83rem;color:var(--ink-muted);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .welcome-btn{
    width:100%;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border:none;padding:13px;border-radius:10px;
    font-weight:700;font-size:0.9rem;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
  }
  .welcome-btn:disabled{background:#c9cfda;cursor:default;}
  .welcome-status{
    display:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--green-deep);font-weight:600;
  }
  .welcome-status.show{display:flex;}

  /* Inline mini survey */
  .mini-survey{display:none;margin-top:14px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);padding-top:14px;}
  .mini-survey.show{display:block;}
  .mini-survey p{font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:10px;font-weight:600;}
  .mini-survey .opt{
    display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:0.83rem;color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;
  }
  .mini-survey .opt:hover{border-color:var(--green);}

  /* ===== Section headers ===== */
  .section-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:22px 0 12px;font-size:1rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);font-family:'Sora',sans-serif;}
  .section-title .sub{margin-left:auto;font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink-muted);}

  /* ===== How payouts work ===== */
  .steps{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin-bottom:6px;}
  .step{
    background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-md);
    padding:12px 14px;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  }
  .step-num{
    width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:700;flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .step-body h4{font-size:0.87rem;margin-bottom:2px;color:var(--navy);}
  .step-body p{font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--ink-muted);line-height:1.4;}

  /* ===== Task cards ===== */
  .task-card{
    background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);
    padding:15px;margin-bottom:12px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  }
  .task-header{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:9px;}
  .task-icon{
    width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:11px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    font-size:1.2rem;flex-shrink:0;color:#fff;
  }
  .task-icon.green{background:var(--green);}
  .task-icon.navy{background:var(--navy);}
  .task-icon.amber{background:var(--amber);}
  .task-content{flex:1;min-width:0;}
  .task-title{font-weight:600;font-size:0.92rem;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:2px;line-height:1.3;}
  .task-company{font-size:0.76rem;color:var(--ink-muted);}
  .task-reward{background:var(--green);color:#fff;padding:5px 10px;border-radius:20px;font-weight:700;font-size:0.8rem;flex-shrink:0;white-space:nowrap;}
  .task-desc{font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--ink-muted);line-height:1.4;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .task-meta{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px;}
  .task-tag{background:#eef4ef;color:#2d5016;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:20px;font-size:0.72rem;font-weight:500;}
  .task-btn{
    width:100%;background:#eef1f6;color:var(--navy);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:11px;border-radius:10px;
    font-weight:600;font-size:0.85rem;cursor:pointer;
  }
  .task-btn:hover{border-color:var(--navy);}

  /* ===== Payout history (real data placeholder, clearly labeled) ===== */
  .history-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:6px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
  .history-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:11px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
  .history-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .history-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;}
  .history-icon{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:#eef4ef;color:var(--green-deep);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:0.8rem;}
  .history-name{font-size:0.82rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);}
  .history-date{font-size:0.7rem;color:var(--ink-muted);}
  .history-amount{font-weight:700;color:var(--green-deep);font-size:0.85rem;}
  .data-note{font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--ink-muted);text-align:center;padding:8px;font-style:italic;}

  /* ===== FAQ ===== */
  .faq-item{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-md);margin-bottom:8px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
  .faq-q{padding:13px 14px;font-size:0.85rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;}
  .faq-q .chev{transition:transform .2s ease;color:var(--ink-muted);}
  .faq-item.open .chev{transform:rotate(180deg);}
  .faq-a{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .25s ease;}
  .faq-item.open .faq-a{max-height:200px;}
  .faq-a p{padding:0 14px 14px;font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--ink-muted);line-height:1.5;}

  /* ===== Support footer ===== */
  .support-card{
    background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:18px;margin:20px 0 8px;
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;
  }
  .support-icon{font-size:1.6rem;}
  .support-text h4{font-size:0.9rem;margin-bottom:3px;}
  .support-text p{font-size:0.76rem;color:#b9c2da;}
  .support-link{margin-left:auto;background:var(--green);color:#fff;border:none;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:8px;font-size:0.78rem;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;}

  .legal-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;justify-content:center;padding:18px 4px 8px;}
  .legal-links a{font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--ink-muted);text-decoration:none;}
  .legal-links a:hover{color:var(--navy);text-decoration:underline;}

  /* ===== Toast ===== */
  .toast{
    position:fixed;bottom:96px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);
    background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:10px;font-size:0.83rem;font-weight:600;
    box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:all .3s ease;z-index:999;
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  }
  .toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);}

  /* ===== Register modal ===== */
  .modal-overlay{
    position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,31,63,0.55);z-index:1000;
    align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;display:none;
  }
  .modal-overlay.show{display:flex;}
  .modal-box{
    background:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:24px 20px;max-width:360px;width:100%;
    text-align:center;box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
  }
  .modal-icon{font-size:2rem;margin-bottom:10px;}
  .modal-title{font-family:'Sora',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:8px;}
  .modal-desc{font-size:0.85rem;color:var(--ink-muted);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:18px;}
  .modal-btn{
    background:var(--navy);color:#ffffff !important;border:none;padding:13px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:700;
    font-size:0.9rem;cursor:pointer;display:block;width:100%;text-decoration:none;margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .modal-cancel{background:none;border:none;color:var(--ink-muted);font-size:0.82rem;cursor:pointer;}

  /* ===== Congrats modal ===== */
  .congrats-icon{
    width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;background:#eef4ef;color:var(--green-deep);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.8rem;margin:0 auto 14px;
  }
  .congrats-amount{
    font-family:'Sora',sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:2rem;color:var(--green-deep);margin-bottom:4px;
  }
  .congrats-amount small{display:block;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-weight:600;font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--ink-muted);margin-top:2px;letter-spacing:0.02em;}
  .congrats-btn{background:var(--navy) !important;color:#ffffff !important;}

  /* ===== Bottom nav ===== */
  .bottom-nav{
    position:fixed;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;background:#fff;display:flex;justify-content:space-around;
    padding:8px 0;box-shadow:0 -2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  }
  .nav-item{
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;padding:6px 12px;color:#8a93a8;text-decoration:none;
    background:none;border:none;-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;outline:none;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
  }
  .nav-item.active{color:var(--green);}
  .nav-icon{font-size:1.3rem;}
  .nav-label{font-size:0.68rem;font-weight:600;}

  @media (max-width:360px){
    .balance-amount{font-size:1.9rem;}
    .btn{font-size:0.8rem;padding:12px 6px;}
  }

  /* ===== In-page tab sections ===== */
  .page-section{display:none;}
  .page-section.active{display:block;}
  .page-heading{font-family:'Sora',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:4px;}
  .page-subheading{font-size:0.83rem;color:var(--ink-muted);margin-bottom:16px;}

  /* Wallet section */
  .withdraw-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
  .field{margin-bottom:14px;}
  .field:last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
  .field label{display:block;font-size:0.8rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:6px;}
  .field input{
    width:100%;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;font-size:0.9rem;
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:#fafcfa;
  }
  .field input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--green);background:#fff;}
  .field .hint{font-size:0.72rem;color:var(--ink-muted);margin-top:5px;}
  .withdraw-btn{
    width:100%;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border:none;padding:13px;border-radius:10px;
    font-weight:700;font-size:0.9rem;cursor:pointer;
  }
  .form-note{
    display:flex;gap:8px;background:#eef4ef;color:#2d5016;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;
    font-size:0.78rem;line-height:1.4;margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .form-msg{font-size:0.8rem;margin-top:10px;text-align:center;font-weight:600;display:none;}
  .form-msg.error{color:#c0392b;display:block;}
  .form-msg.success{color:var(--green-deep);display:block;}
  .empty-state{padding:24px;text-align:center;color:var(--ink-muted);font-size:0.82rem;}

  /* Refer section */
  .code-card{
    background:var(--card);border:1.5px solid rgba(47,174,62,0.35);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);
    padding:18px;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  }
  .code-label{font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--ink-muted);margin-bottom:8px;}
  .code-value{font-family:'Sora',sans-serif;font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:0.05em;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .code-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;}
  .code-btn{flex:1;padding:12px;border-radius:10px;border:none;font-weight:700;font-size:0.85rem;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;}
  .code-btn.copy{background:#eef1f6;color:var(--navy);border:1px solid var(--line);}
  .code-btn.share{background:var(--green);color:#fff;text-decoration:none;}
  .copy-msg{font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--green-deep);font-weight:600;margin-top:8px;display:none;}
  .copy-msg.show{display:block;}
  .stats-row{display:flex;gap:10px;}
  .stat-card{flex:1;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-md);padding:14px 10px;text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
  .stat-value{font-family:'Sora',sans-serif;font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);}
  .stat-label{font-size:0.68rem;color:var(--ink-muted);margin-top:2px;}

  /* Profile section */
  .avatar-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .avatar{
    width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);color:#fff;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:'Sora',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.2rem;flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .avatar-name{font-family:'Sora',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--navy);}
  .avatar-sub{font-size:0.78rem;color:var(--ink-muted);margin-top:2px;}
  .form-card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius-lg);padding:18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}

<script>
  // Tab switching — all four "pages" live in this one file and toggle without a reload.
  function showSection(name){
    document.querySelectorAll('.page-section').forEach(el => {
      el.classList.toggle('active', el.dataset.section === name);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(el => {
      el.classList.toggle('active', el.dataset.nav === name);
    });
    window.scrollTo({top: 0, behavior: 'instant'});
  }

  // Register modal
  function openRegisterModal(){
    document.getElementById('registerModal').classList.add('show');
  }
  function closeRegisterModal(){
    document.getElementById('registerModal').classList.remove('show');
  }

  // Wallet: withdrawal form
  const MIN_WITHDRAWAL = 200;
  function submitWithdrawal(){
    const msg = document.getElementById('formMsg');
    const number = document.getElementById('mpesaNumber').value.trim();
    const amount = parseFloat(document.getElementById('withdrawAmount').value);
    const balance = parseInt(document.getElementById('balanceAmount').textContent.replace(/,/g,'')) || 0;

    msg.className = 'form-msg';

    if (!number || number.length < 9){
      msg.textContent = 'Enter a valid M-Pesa number.';
      msg.classList.add('error');
      return;
    }
    if (!amount || amount < MIN_WITHDRAWAL){
      msg.textContent = 'Minimum withdrawal is KSh ' + MIN_WITHDRAWAL + '.';
      msg.classList.add('error');
      return;
    }
    if (amount > balance){
      msg.textContent = "That's more than your available balance.";
      msg.classList.add('error');
      return;
    }

    // In production: POST this request to your backend, which initiates the real
    // M-Pesa B2C payout and only then updates the balance and history.
    msg.textContent = "Withdrawal requested — you'll receive an M-Pesa prompt shortly.";
    msg.classList.add('success');
  }

  // Refer: copy code
  function copyCode(){
    const code = document.getElementById('refCode').textContent.trim();
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {
      const cmsg = document.getElementById('copyMsg');
      cmsg.classList.add('show');
      setTimeout(() => cmsg.classList.remove('show'), 2200);
    });
  }

  // Profile: save changes
  function saveProfile(){
    // In production: PATCH these fields to your backend and validate the M-Pesa number.
    const smsg = document.getElementById('saveMsg');
    smsg.classList.add('show');
    setTimeout(() => smsg.classList.remove('show'), 2200);
  }

  // Welcome task: 5 real questions about social media use, then credits the balance once, honestly.
  const WELCOME_REWARD = 120;
  const TOTAL_QUESTIONS = 5;
  let welcomeClaimed = false; // in production, drive this from the user's real account state
  let currentQ = 1;
  const answers = {};

  function startWelcomeTask(){
    document.getElementById('miniSurvey').classList.add('show');
    document.getElementById('welcomeBtn').style.display = 'none';
  }

  function answerQuestion(step, value){
    answers[step] = value; // in production: send each answer to your backend as it's collected
    document.querySelector('.q-step[data-step="' + step + '"]').style.display = 'none';

    if (step < TOTAL_QUESTIONS){
      currentQ = step + 1;
      document.querySelector('.q-step[data-step="' + currentQ + '"]').style.display = 'block';
      document.getElementById('qProgress').textContent = 'Question ' + currentQ + ' of ' + TOTAL_QUESTIONS;
    } else {
      finishWelcomeTask();
    }
  }

  // Congrats modal
  function openCongratsModal(amount){
    const el = document.getElementById('congratsModal');
    el.querySelector('.congrats-amount').innerHTML = 'KSh ' + amount.toLocaleString() + '<small>ADDED TO YOUR BALANCE</small>';
    el.classList.add('show');
  }
  function closeCongratsModal(){
    document.getElementById('congratsModal').classList.remove('show');
  }

  function finishWelcomeTask(){
    if (welcomeClaimed) return;
    welcomeClaimed = true;

    // In production: POST all 5 answers + credit request to your backend,
    // which verifies this is the user's first completion before crediting.
    document.getElementById('miniSurvey').classList.remove('show');
    document.getElementById('welcomeStatus').classList.add('show');

    const balanceEl = document.getElementById('balanceAmount');
    const current = parseInt(balanceEl.textContent.replace(/,/g,'')) || 0;
    balanceEl.textContent = (current + WELCOME_REWARD).toLocaleString();

    // Reflect the completed task on the Profile tab too.
    document.getElementById('profileTasksDone').textContent = '1';
    document.getElementById('profileTotalEarned').textContent = 'KSh ' + WELCOME_REWARD;

    showToast('✅ KSh 120 added — thanks for sharing');
    openCongratsModal(WELCOME_REWARD);
  }

  function openWithdraw(){
    showSection('wallet');
  }

  function showToast(msg){
    const t = document.getElementById('toast');
    t.textContent = msg;
    t.classList.add('show');
    setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), 3200);
  }
</script>
</body>
